en.content:
The countdown to Black Friday is on, and the first discounts are starting to appear. Although the shopping holiday isn’t officially until November 27th, retailers are already dropping early deals on some of our favorite tech. Of course, with prices rising across the board, a good discount doesn’t necessarily mean you’re getting a historically low price. But we’re still seeing worthwhile discounts on a host of tried-and-tested gear, with more expected in the coming weeks.
Below, we’ve rounded up the best early Black Friday deals we’ve found so far. Prices could drop further as Black Friday approaches, as is always the case, but these deals are worth considering if you’d rather shop early and beat the holiday rush. We’ll continue to update this guide as more retailers launch their holiday sales, too, so be sure to check back regularly as we get closer to the main event.
Ember Mug 3 (14-ounce)
Ember’s latest smart mug is designed to keep your coffee at the ideal temperature for up to three hours, with five temp settings between 120 and 145 degrees Fahrenheit. The third-gen version is similar to prior models; however, you can now adjust the heat settings directly on the mug and throw it in the dishwasher, which wasn’t the case before.

Where to Buy:

 $149.95 $99.99 at Amazon
 $149.95 $99.99 at Best Buy
 $149.95 $99.99 at Ember

Hisense CanvasTV (2026)
Hisense’s 2026 CanvasTV is a 4K QLED TV that doubles as wall art when you’re not watching. It features a matte, anti-glare display and runs on Google’s excellent TV software; it’s also a great pick for gamers thanks to its snappy 144Hz variable refresh rate and a pair of HDMI 2.1 ports.

Where to Buy:

 $1499.99 $797.99 at Amazon (55-inch)
 $1499.99 $799.99 at Best Buy (55-inch)
 $1999.99 $997.99 at Amazon (65-inch)

Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 Combo
The Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 Combo is a beginner-friendly 3D printer that supports four filament spools. It features an enclosed build chamber, automatic bed leveling, and a large touchscreen, making it easy to produce reliable prints.

Where to Buy:

 $449 $369 at Elegoo

Moft Trackable Tripod Wallet
Moft’s Trackable Tripod Wallet is a MagSafe-compatible wallet that holds two cards and folds into an adjustable phone stand or small tripod. It also supports both Apple’s Find My network and Google’s Find Hub, offers Qi wireless charging, and includes a detachable shutter remote for taking photos.

Where to Buy:

 $59.99 $50.99 at Amazon

Govee Christmas String Lights 2
Govee’s Christmas lights offer over 130 preset lighting effects, though you can also create your own custom light displays. The IP65-rated lights feature Matter support, so they’ll work with any major smart home platform, and are sold in lengths up to 328 feet with up to 1,000 LED beads.

Where to Buy:

 $99.99 $74.99 at Amazon (66-foot)
 $129.99 $96.99 at Amazon (99-foot)
 $199.99 $149.99 at Amazon (164-foot)

Govee Table Lamp 2
Govee’s Table Lamp 2 is way more fun than your average table lamp.

en.content:
Looking for a MacBook and device charger that’s as stylish as it is capable? Both Amazon and Sharge are selling the Pixel 140W GaN charger for $69.88 and $69.90, respectively, a $24 discount on its usual price. If you’re not in need of that much wattage but like the style, Sharge is also selling the 67W version for $19.90 ($30 off) or the 100W version for $59.90 ($16 off).
Sharge Pixel 140 GaN Charger

Where to Buy:

 $90.9 $69.88 at Amazon
 $90.9 $69.9 at Sharge

The Pixel 140 delivers up to 140W of power when using only one of its three USB-C ports, which Sharge says is capable of taking a 16-inch MacBook Pro from a flat battery to 50 percent charge in just 25 minutes. It’s 47 percent smaller than the MacBook’s included charging brick as well, which is great if you’re tight on bag space or travel frequently. The pixel display on the side has configurable brightness and orientation, and displays your current charging wattage.
Other deals to consider
Halo fans looking for a fun weeknight project can grab Mattel’s Brick Shop Warthog on Amazon for $62.99 ($12 off), which is the lowest price we’ve seen on the brick-ified UNSC replica. The 935-piece set lets you recreate a 1:22 scale model of the iconic land vehicle, and includes a 1:64 scale metal version as well.
Windows users with Mac Mini envy might consider the Lenovo Yoga Mini, which is currently discounted to $599.99 ($460 off) at Best Buy as part of the retailer’s early Black Friday promo. The compact desktop PC features an Intel Core Ultra 5 processor, 16GB of LPDDR5X memory, and 512GB of storage; it also has several fun features, including automated lighting around the system and Wi-Fi presence sensing.
While modern smartphone camera stabilization has improved dramatically, there are still plenty of situations where a motorized gimbal can help you capture a smoother shot. Fortunately, the DJI Osmo Mobile 8 is currently on sale at Amazon for $89 ($20 off), nearly matching its best price to date. It features 360-degree horizontal panning and over 10 hours of battery life on a single charge.

en.title: Sony’s latest Pulse wireless headset packs planar magnetic drivers at a good price
en.summary:
It's tempting to seek out the do-everything wireless gaming headset with noise cancellation, phenomenal sound quality, multiplatform connectivity, swappable batteries - you name it. But if you just want the basics done well, Sony's new $99.99 PlayStation Pulse headset is worth considering. It has very good sound and just enough extras, even if you use more gadgets than just your PlayStation 5.
Inside the Pulse's nondescript ear cup shells are custom planar magnetic drivers, which deliver clean, detailed sound whether you're gaming, listening to music, or both. They aren't bass-heavy or too shr

en.title: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
en.summary:
Project Screen Test lets you talk with AI-generated characters to shape their personality. | Image: Adobe	

Some of the most impressive tech that Adobe showcases at its annual Max conference each year is the experimental features it's developing, and the latest of those tools are being announced today: they can transform images into explorable 3D scenes, design AI characters by talking to them, and turn photo editing into a copy/paste process.
The first (and weirdest, in my opinion) is Project Screen Test, which is designed to make AI-generated characters easier to develop and use for video co
en.content:
Project Screen Test lets you talk with AI-generated characters to shape their personality. | Image: Adobe	

Some of the most impressive tech that Adobe showcases at its annual Max conference each year is the experimental features it's developing, and the latest of those tools are being announced today: they can transform images into explorable 3D scenes, design AI characters by talking to them, and turn photo editing into a copy/paste process.
The first (and weirdest, in my opinion) is Project Screen Test, which is designed to make AI-generated characters easier to develop and use for video content. Instead of just describing how the character should sound and behave in text prompts, the tool lets you talk to the character and direct them in an a …
Read the full story at The Verge.

en.title: Show HN: I created a library for correctly using SQLite in Go programs
en.summary:
Using SQLite in Go is deceptively easy. If you just import the popular github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3 as the database/sql driver implementation and start making queries, things will work great until you start hitting SQLITE_BUSY errors as traffic increases.

Then you go down the same path of many gophers before you, finding GitHub and forum posts providing conflicting information on best practices for pragma values and connection handling.

So I created https://github.com/cattleclou
en.content:
Using SQLite in Go is deceptively easy. If you just import the popular github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3 as the database/sql driver implementation and start making queries, things will work great until you start hitting SQLITE_BUSY errors as traffic increases.

Then you go down the same path of many gophers before you, finding GitHub and forum posts providing conflicting information on best practices for pragma values and connection handling.

So I created https://github.com/cattlecloud/litesql

Which provides a nice abstraction, making it easy to accidentally do the right things when using SQLite in your Go program. In particular it pools connections for read transactions and isolates a dedicated write connection for writes. It also sets pragma values to much more reasonable defaults, like isolation levels, foreign keys, cache sizes, etc. On top it provides a nice abstraction for creating periodic snapshots with retention policies. There is also litesqltest for one-line test database creation in unit tests.

Hopefully you or your agents might find it useful.

en.title: Show HN: ThingStudio, Node-RED style programming for microcontrollers
en.summary:
Hi, I'm Mike,
I've made ThingStudio, a flow programing environment for microcontrollers. It allows drag and drop programming Node-RED style, but emits MicroPython which it uploads to the micro. The board does not need the editor to run after that. Runs fully local, Apache 2 licensed.
There's a functional version of the editor/IDE at linked to the home page, you'll need to install to be able to upload, because WebSerial is not universal.
Please give it a whirl. I'm happy to answer any questions.

en.title: Show HN: Black Ops II statically recompiled to native ARM64 macOS
en.summary: I grew up with Black Ops 2 and wanted to see if I could make it work on my 2020 MacBook Pro. So I used Claude Opus 5.5 to create a tool that converts your copy of the game (from Steam) to a native ARM64 Mac app, with almost 60fps in all areas. The whole game is statically recompilated ahead-of-time (AOT) and does not use any emulator whatsoever, be it Wine, Crossover or Rosetta. The best thing is the performance, although some heat issues are still to fix. You get to play the whole Campaign, local Multiplayer (with bots) and local Zombies (all DLCs maps; you need to have them in your Steam lib
en.content: I grew up with Black Ops 2 and wanted to see if I could make it work on my 2020 MacBook Pro. So I used Claude Opus 5.5 to create a tool that converts your copy of the game (from Steam) to a native ARM64 Mac app, with almost 60fps in all areas. The whole game is statically recompilated ahead-of-time (AOT) and does not use any emulator whatsoever, be it Wine, Crossover or Rosetta. The best thing is the performance, although some heat issues are still to fix. You get to play the whole Campaign, local Multiplayer (with bots) and local Zombies (all DLCs maps; you need to have them in your Steam library obviously) at about 60fps. Split-screen was not in the PC version, but I've been working on it lately; it's coming soon! LAN mode is on the roadmap for later too :)

en.title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
en.summary:
As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world's most valuable companies, controls the in-demand technology fueling the AI boom, and is cozy with presidents, CEOs, and all manner of important people. He also wears a cool leather jacket.
Which makes Huang's admission that he had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy - reportedly while her spying was known to US intelligence and even President Donald Trump - all the more shocking. The fallout goes well beyond his marriage, his reputation, or Nvidia its

en.title: Show HN: Get your coding agent off ~2019 JavaScript, onto modern web primitives
en.summary:
Browsers natively handle a lot of what used to take 50 lines of JS (or a dependency): `CSS.highlights` for text range highlighting without <span>s everywhere, `<dialog>` and showModal() give you backdrops and ideal focus management, `field-sizing` to auto-grow textareas as the user types.. (Something yesterday's ftrain post touched on [0])

Models know about some of these by name, but consistently won't default to using the platform-native solution and instead prefer the incumbent <div>+JS based pattern. We started an effort in Chrome to supplement coding agents w
en.content:
Browsers natively handle a lot of what used to take 50 lines of JS (or a dependency): `CSS.highlights` for text range highlighting without <span>s everywhere, `<dialog>` and showModal() give you backdrops and ideal focus management, `field-sizing` to auto-grow textareas as the user types.. (Something yesterday's ftrain post touched on [0])

Models know about some of these by name, but consistently won't default to using the platform-native solution and instead prefer the incumbent <div>+JS based pattern. We started an effort in Chrome to supplement coding agents with this key domain knowledge and we're shipping our 1.0 today, in collaboration with Firefox, MDN, and Edge.

200+ guides (~1.7MB) of curated, hand-crafted implementation best-practices from web experts, updated as the web evolves. (Open source, obv, so.. we'll welcome your bikeshedding ;) Readable versions here: [1]

I've spent the last 9 months obsessing over how to ship this as an agent skill + (Agentic RAG) CLI without blowing up your context window. (Or cedeing activation mechanics to MCP dynamic tool search). The skill description is minmaxed for activating on relevant frontend tasks. The RAG work I'm pretty proud of… originally a 500mb native stack down to a ~7MB pure-JS package, ~10ms search on your CPU.

We just introduced a deterministic 'legacy-scan' (trained on 30k github repos) to identify old 'n dusted patterns that your agent can modernize. (92% avg precision on held-out repos.)

People make a lot of claims about what coding agents are good/bad at. We wanted receipts, so we invested heavily in eval infra [2] to help us hill-climb, but also to identify when knowledge is common enough we can prune our guides. (Ofc, some of the things we thought AI didn't know turned out to be wrong :) We run codex/claude/agy against 200 tasks without the skill and then with.. In total ~1,700 playwright/AST-based assertions. Agents go from 55% pass unguided to 92% guided.

Try it out:

    DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest install
    DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate dialog modal"
    DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan ./src
If you spot something wrong or weird, give us a holler!

Longer write-up on the 1.0: https://developer.chrome.com/blog/modern-web-guidance-v1

Browsers natively handle a lot of what used to take 50 lines of JS (or a dependency): `CSS.highlights` for text range highlighting without <span>s everywhere, `<dialog>` and showModal() give you backdrops and ideal focus management, `field-sizing` to auto-grow textareas as the user types.. (Something yesterday's ftrain post touched on [0])

Models know about some of these by name, but consistently won't default to using the platform-native solution and instead prefer the incumbent <div>+JS based pattern. We started an effort in Chrome to supplement coding agents w
it.content:
Browsers natively handle a lot of what used to take 50 lines of JS (or a dependency): `CSS.highlights` for text range highlighting without <span>s everywhere, `<dialog>` and showModal() give you backdrops and ideal focus management, `field-sizing` to auto-grow textareas as the user types.. (Something yesterday's ftrain post touched on [0])

Models know about some of these by name, but consistently won't default to using the platform-native solution and instead prefer the incumbent <div>+JS based pattern. We started an effort in Chrome to supplement coding agents with this key domain knowledge and we're shipping our 1.0 today, in collaboration with Firefox, MDN, and Edge.

200+ guides (~1.7MB) of curated, hand-crafted implementation best-practices from web experts, updated as the web evolves. (Open source, obv, so.. we'll welcome your bikeshedding ;) Readable versions here: [1]

I've spent the last 9 months obsessing over how to ship this as an agent skill + (Agentic RAG) CLI without blowing up your context window. (Or cedeing activation mechanics to MCP dynamic tool search). The skill description is minmaxed for activating on relevant frontend tasks. The RAG work I'm pretty proud of… originally a 500mb native stack down to a ~7MB pure-JS package, ~10ms search on your CPU.

We just introduced a deterministic 'legacy-scan' (trained on 30k github repos) to identify old 'n dusted patterns that your agent can modernize. (92% avg precision on held-out repos.)

People make a lot of claims about what coding agents are good/bad at. We wanted receipts, so we invested heavily in eval infra [2] to help us hill-climb, but also to identify when knowledge is common enough we can prune our guides. (Ofc, some of the things we thought AI didn't know turned out to be wrong :) We run codex/claude/agy against 200 tasks without the skill and then with.. In total ~1,700 playwright/AST-based assertions. Agents go from 55% pass unguided to 92% guided.

Try it out:

    DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest install
    DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate dialog modal"
    DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan ./src
If you spot something wrong or weird, give us a holler!

Longer write-up on the 1.0: https://developer.chrome.com/blog/modern-web-guidance-v1

en.title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
en.summary:

The feature, available first to "eligible" e-commerce and online service businesses in the US, is launching as part of a suite of business-focused features in ChatGPT being announced today in beta.

en.title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
en.summary:
Some Independent Games Festival (IGF) jurors published a statement yesterday saying they would not vote for games that use generative AI in "any capacity." Soon after, the developer of indie hit Big Walk has published a statement saying it "sparingly" used AI in the "final stretch" of the game's development to "help work through difficult technical challenges and bugs."
According to the jurors' statement, a copy of which was posted by Austin Walker, while this year's IGF entries have been "incredible," there has been "a significant increase" in the number of games "developed with generative AI

Soon after, the developer of indie hit Big Walk has published a statement saying it "sparingly" used AI in the "final stretch" of the game's development to "help work through difficult technical challenges and bugs."
According to the jurors' statement, a copy of which was posted by Austin Walker, while this year's IGF entries have been "incredible," there has been "a significant increase" in the number of games "developed with generative AI tools," leading to "fairly intense discussion a …

en.summary:
eBay appears to have blocked AI agents, including Meta's Muse, from browsing on the platform - the latest speed bump in the AI agent race.
A reader tells The Verge that for several weeks he's had his Muse agent browse and curate a daily digest of watches for sale on platforms like eBay, including a link to listings, price, shipping details, and relevant notes about condition or style. This weekend, though, Muse was unable to pull any links or details from eBay, with Muse saying it was blocked from the site. en.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO
en.summary:
Anthropic confirmed on Tuesday that its IPO could be one of the biggest ever, even while falling short of previous expectations. Its IPO price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share, which would put its valuation as high as $1.4 trillion, according to the The New York Times. The Wall Street Journal reports that according to its sources, Anthropic is "aiming for its shares to start trading Thursday or Friday next week."
As Reuters notes, the Anthropic IPO was previously expected to be valued at as much as $2 trillion. As of last week, Anthropic's rival OpenAI was valued at $1.25

en.title: OpenAI Surpasses $10 Billion in Revenue for the First Time
en.summary: According to Bloomberg, OpenAI has surpassed $10 billion in revenue for the first time, driven by strong demand for its AI models.
en.content: OpenAI has surpassed $10 billion in revenue for the first time, according to Bloomberg, driven by strong demand for its AI models. This represents a 50% increase over the $6.7 billion in revenue recorded in the second quarter. The company's profitability picture has also improved, with the adjusted operating income rate falling from -150% in the second quarter to -109% in the third quarter. OpenAI has benefited from a strong focus on creating products and agents of AI focused on the industry, which has allowed it to attract a large number of users. However, its main competitor Anthropic has taken the lead in the industry for AI models, with its sales in the third quarter exceeding $10 billion for the first time. OpenAI has achieved a revenue run rate of over $50 billion for the year, according to Bloomberg.

tr.summary: OpenAI'nin üçüncü aylık geliri $10 milyardi üstü, Bloomberg'a göre, strong demand for its AI models ile sürüncüye geçmiştir.
tr.content: OpenAI'nin üçüncü aylık geliri $10 milyardi üstü, Bloomberg'a göre, strong demand for its AI models ile sürüncüye geçmiştir. Bu, $6.7 milyar olan ikinci aylık gelirden 50% artıştır. Şirketin gelir picture değişiminde de improvements görülmüştür, second quarter'da -150% olan adjusted operating margin, third quarter'da -109%ye indirmiştir. OpenAI'nin recent focus on building enterprise-focused products and AI agents, company'a büyük bir kitleye hitap etmesine yardımcı olmuştur. Ancak, arch-rival Anthropic, AI models için enterprise marketi ele geçirmeye devam ediyor, annual revenue run rate'i $10 milyar artırmış, $81 milyar olarak hesaplanmıştır. OpenAI'nin annual revenue run rate'i $50 milyar olarak hesaplanmıştır.

es.title: OpenAI's Cuarto Trimestre Recauda $10 Mil Millones por Primera Vez
es.summary: Según Bloomberg, OpenAI ha superado los $10 mil millones en cuarto trimestre, impulsado por la gran demanda de sus modelos de inteligencia artificial.
es.content: OpenAI ha superado los $10 mil millones en cuarto trimestre, impulsado por la gran demanda de sus modelos de inteligencia artificial, según Bloomberg. Esto representa un aumento del 50% en comparación con los $6.7 mil millones de ventas registradas en el segundo trimestre. La imagen de rentabilidad del empresa también ha mejorado, con su margen de operación ajustado disminuyendo de -150% en el segundo trimestre a -109% en el tercer trimestre. La empresa ha beneficiado de su enfoque en la creación de productos y agentes de inteligencia artificial enfocados en la industria, lo que le ha permitido atraer a una gran cantidad de usuarios. Sin embargo, su rival principal Anthropic ha liderado la competencia por el mercado de la industria para los modelos de inteligencia artificial, con su cuarto trimestre de ventas aumentando en $10 mil millones en un solo mes hasta $81 mil millones. OpenAI ha alcanzado un ritmo de ingresos anuales de $50 mil millones, según Bloomberg.

en.content: The AI industry is still reeling from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's honeypot scandal, but some in the industry see it as an issue that's much larger than one man. The Chinese government has been active in economic espionage for decades, and with semiconductors at the center of the AI boom, there's intense pressure to infiltrate any company involved. Heron Intelligence CEO Nate Singer says there are lots of similar cases in the semiconductor industry that have stayed under the radar. Semiconductor companies are already big targets for international trade secret theft, and the ongoing threat has become a kind of open secret in the industry.

en.title: Siri Co-Founder Backs Helix for Its Voice ID Tech
en.summary: Helix, a startup using voice technology to verify users' identities, has secured backing from Siri co-founder Dag Kittlaus. The company aims to replace CAPTCHA with its voice-based solution, attracting funding from prominent venture capital firms.
en.content: For years, websites have relied on technology like CAPTCHA to prove that the user on the other end is human. More recently, social media platforms have turned to photos or videos to verify users' identities. Now, a startup called Helix is betting that voice technology can do the same job, without requiring users to hand over sensitive personal information. The voice technology, which can run directly on a user's device, has attracted backing from Siri co-founder Dag Kittlaus, who will also act as an advisor. The company raised $6 million in funding in a round led by Chicago Ventures, with participation from BAM Ventures, Aglaé Ventures, Corazon Capital, Tusk Ventures, Yonder Ventures, Rule30, and Brown Alumni Group. The startup was founded by Alex Oberg, Anna Dorofiyenko, and Mike Hall in 2025. Oberg previously worked at Ticketmaster, which acquired his startup; Dorofiyenko led data science teams at Live Nation and Zillow; and Hall has worked at Nike and Tinder, where he helped develop the initial matching algorithm. At Ticketmaster, Oberg played a role in creating Verified Fan, which is designed to keep bots out of the platform. As AI advanced, he started thinking along the same lines for a new solution. “As AI started to come up in the last two years, I was realizing that it’s going to make it increasingly difficult to determine who’s human and who’s not on the Internet. Identity on the Internet’s always been about proxies for identity, right? It’s your email, it’s your phone, it’s your IP address, it’s your device fingerprint, it’s your device ID,” Oberg said. He noted that with the rise of AI agents like Instinct and Muse, the industry needs to rethink human identity on the internet and rely on biometric signals like voice, which is where Helix comes in. Its core technology can run directly on a device to determine whether someone is human and estimate their age. The company is also running pilots to explore whether voice can be used a biomarker to detect conditions such as adrunkenness or distress. The company can deploy its technology to replace or supplement CAPTCHA and help block bot attacks. Helix said that because its model can run locally even on an iPhone 13, the cost of deploying the technology is minimal. The startup said one of its customers is Zeel, an in-home healthcare provider that uses Helix’s tech to verify the identities of providers visiting customers’ homes.

es.title: Siri Co-Founder apoya a Helix en su solución de reconocimiento de voz

es.content: En los últimos años, los sitios web han utilizado tecnologías como CAPTCHA para verificar si el usuario en otro lado del Internet es humano. En los últimos años, las plataformas de redes sociales han utilizado fotos o videos para verificar la identidad de los usuarios. La tecnología de reconocimiento de voz, que puede funcionar directamente en el dispositivo del usuario, ha obtenido el apoyo de Dag Kittlaus, que será también asesor. La empresa ha recaudado 6 millones de dólares en una ronda de financiamiento liderada por Chicago Ventures, con la participación de BAM Ventures, Aglaé Ventures, Corazon Capital, Tusk Ventures, Yonder Ventures, Rule30 y Brown Alumni Group. La startup fue fundada en 2025 por Alex Oberg, Anna Dorofiyenko y Mike Hall. Oberg trabajó en Ticketmaster, que adquirió la startup; Dorofiyenko lideró equipos de ciencia de datos en Live Nation y Zillow; y Hall trabajó en Nike y Tinder, donde contribuyó al proyecto de reconocimiento de correspondencia inicial. En Ticketmaster, Oberg jugó un papel en la creación de Verified Fan, que está diseñada para alejar a los bots de la plataforma. Cuando el modelo de AI avanzó, Oberg comenzó a pensar en una solución que fuera similar. “Si el modelo de AI avanzó tanto rápido que nos impidió saber si alguien era humano en otro lado del Internet, entonces debemos preguntarnos cómo definimos nuestra identidad en el mundo digital. La identidad en el mundo digital siempre se basa en proxys para la identidad, o? Es tu dirección de correo electrónico, tu teléfono, tu dirección IP, tus huellas digitales, tu identificador de dispositivo,” dijo Oberg. Notó que con la liberación de agentes como Instinct y Muse, la industria debe adaptarse para definir su identidad en el mundo digital y adoptar señales biológicas como la voz, que lleva Helix a la escena. La principal tecnología de la empresa puede funcionar directamente en el dispositivo para determinar si alguien es humano y estimar su edad. La empresa está llevando a cabo pruebas para descubrir si la voz puede ser utilizada como biomarca para reconocer determinadas condiciones como el alcoholismo o la ansiedad. La empresa puede utilizar su tecnología para reemplazar o integrar CAPTCHA y combatir los bots. Helix dijo que su modelo puede funcionar incluso en un iPhone 13, lo que permite minimizar los costos. La startup dijo que una de sus clientes es Zeel, un proveedor de servicios de salud, que utiliza la tecnología de Helix para verificar la identidad de los empleados que visitan a los clientes en sus casas.

de.title: Plurai Aims to Boost AI Agent Reliability with Simulation Techniques Used in Self-Driving Cars
de.summary: Startup Plurai seeks to enhance AI agent performance using simulations based on synthetic data, similar to those used in self-driving cars, to tackle complex edge cases and improve reliability.
de.content: AI agents are not yet as capable as their proponents claim, with benchmarking efforts revealing they often require close supervision to function reliably. Plurai aims to address this issue by creating digital twins of companies' electronic systems and mapping possible agent flows to prepare models for edge cases. The platform works alongside existing agentic tools and has raised $13 million in seed funding.
keyTakeaways: Plurai uses simulation techniques similar to those used in self-driving cars to enhance AI agent reliability.
The startup creates digital twins of companies' electronic systems to prepare models for edge cases.
Plurai's platform works alongside existing agentic tools to improve AI agent performance.
The company has raised $13 million in seed funding to support its development.
Plurai aims to tackle complex edge cases and improve reliability in AI agents.

en.title: OpenAI Launches Verified Business Profiles in ChatGPT to Challenge Google Search
en.summary: OpenAI has officially introduced Business Profiles within ChatGPT, allowing enterprises and local brands to display verified locations, services, and live support directly in chat interactions.
en.content:
In a direct competitive strike against Google Search and local business directories, OpenAI announced Business Profiles inside ChatGPT. The feature gives verified companies an official interactive footprint where ChatGPT users can see real-time opening hours, book reservations, and query enterprise-level catalogs without leaving the conversational interface.

The rollout represents OpenAI's aggressive transition from an AI answer engine into a transactional commerce layer. Similar to Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business), verified organizations get dedicated digital real estate with verified badges, structured data citations, and authenticated customer-service bridges.

Industry analysts note this move signals a tectonic shift in Local SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Businesses must now optimize their knowledge bases not merely for web crawlers, but directly for conversational LLM agents that execute commerce decisions on behalf of end users.
keyTakeaways: OpenAI introduces verified Business Profiles inside ChatGPT interfaces.
Direct alternative to Google Business Profile for conversational discovery and commerce.
Enables real-time bookings, location mapping, and direct enterprise customer connections.
Marks the rise of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) over traditional Google PageRank.
Enterprises can claim and verify their profiles via OpenAI's new developer and business dashboard.

tr.title: OpenAI, Google Arama'ya Rakip Oluyor: ChatGPT'ye Doğrulanmış İşletme Profilleri Geldi
tr.summary: OpenAI, ChatGPT içine Doğrulanmış İşletme Profillerini entegre etti. İşletmeler artık kullanıcılarla doğrudan sohbet üzerinden randevu, konum ve kurumsal destek sunabilecek.
tr.content:
OpenAI, Google'ın arama ve harita egemenliğine doğrudan meydan okuyan 'ChatGPT İşletme Profilleri' (Business Profiles) özelliğini duyurdu. Yeni sistem sayesinde doğrulanmış şirketler ve yerel işletmeler; çalışma saatleri, ürün katalogları ve doğrudan müşteri iletişim kanallarını ChatGPT sohbet ekranı içerisinde kullanıcılara sunabilecek.

Bu hamle, OpenAI'ın yalnızca bir bilgi motoru olmaktan çıkıp kullanıcılar adına eylem gerçekleştiren ve satın alma işlemlerini yöneten bir ticaret ekosistemine dönüştüğünü kanıtlıyor. Google My Business (Google İşletmem) benzeri bir onay rozeti mekanizmasıyla çalışan sistem, markaların yapay zeka tarafından doğru ve güncel bilgilerle tavsiye edilmesini sağlıyor.

Teknoloji ve SEO uzmanlarına göre bu gelişme 'Üretici Motor Optimizasyonu' (GEO) çağını resmen başlattı. Artık şirketlerin sadece geleneksel Google algoritmalarına değil, doğrudan kullanıcıların adına karar veren yapay zeka ajanlarına yönelik dijital varlık oluşturması zorunlu hale geliyor.
keyTakeaways: OpenAI, ChatGPT içinde resmi ve doğrulanmış İşletme Profilleri özelliğini kullanıma sundu.
Google İşletmem (Google Business Profile) modeline yapay zeka tabanlı doğrudan alternatif.
Sohbetten çıkmadan rezervasyon, doğrudan iletişim ve güncel servis bilgisi erişimi.
Geleneksel SEO yerini 'Üretici Motor Optimizasyonu'na (GEO) bırakıyor.
Şirketler yeni OpenAI kurumsal paneli üzerinden profillerini tescilleyip yönetebilecek.

es.title: OpenAI Desafía a Google Search: Llegan los Perfiles de Negocios Verificados a ChatGPT
es.summary: OpenAI presenta los Perfiles de Negocios en ChatGPT, permitiendo a las empresas interactuar directamente con los clientes con datos verificados y reservas.
es.content:
En un movimiento estratégico contra Google Search, OpenAI anunció el lanzamiento de Perfiles de Negocios dentro de ChatGPT. La nueva herramienta permite que comercios y empresas globales cuenten con presencia verificada, con horarios, catlogos y reservas interactivas.

Este despliegue convierte a ChatGPT en una capa activa de comercio conversacional, superando el modelo tradicional de directorios web y posicionando la Inteligencia Artificial como el principal punto de contacto comercial.

Especialistas en marketing digital destacan que la Optimización para Motores Generativos (GEO) será crucial para las empresas que deseen ser recomendadas por agentes inteligentes.
keyTakeaways: Lanzamiento de perfiles comerciales verificados dentro de ChatGPT.
Competencia frontal contra los directorios y fichas de Google Business.
Soporte para reservas y atención interactiva en tiempo real.
Evolución del SEO tradicional hacia la optimización generativa (GEO).
Gestión centralizada mediante el nuevo panel corporativo de OpenAI.

fr.title: OpenAI s'attaque à Google : Lancement des Profils d'Entreprise Vérifiés dans ChatGPT
fr.summary: OpenAI déploie des Profils Professionnels au sein de ChatGPT, permettant aux entreprises de proposer réservations et informations vérifiées directement dans le chat.
fr.content:
OpenAI bouscule l'hégémonie de Google avec l'introduction des Profils d'Entreprise au sein de ChatGPT. Les entreprises peuvent désormais afficher des informations officielles, prendre des rendez-vous et interagir directement avec des millions d'utilisateurs.

Cette fonctionnalité transforme ChatGPT en un carrefour de commerce conversationnel où l'utilisateur n'a plus besoin de naviguer sur le web traditionnel pour finaliser une transaction.

Les experts soulignent l'avènement de l'optimisation pour moteurs génératifs (GEO), obligeant les marques à repenser entièrement leur référencement pour les assistants IA.
keyTakeaways: Intégration officielle des profils d'entreprise certifiés dans ChatGPT.
Alternative directe aux fiches d'établissement Google.
Interaction commerciale fluide et prise de rendez-vous intégrée.
Transition du SEO classique vers le Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
Tableau de bord dédié aux professionnels pour la gestion des données.

Mit einem direkten Angriff auf die Google-Suche hat OpenAI verifizierte Unternehmensprofile in ChatGPT gestartet. Unternehmen erhalten dadurch verifizierte Präsenzen direkt in der Konversationsoberfläche.

Der Schritt markiert den Übergang von ChatGPT von einer reinen Antwortmaschine zu einer vollwertigen Handels- und Transaktionsplattform.

Experten sehen darin den Startschuss für Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), das traditionelle Suchmaschinenoptimierung schrittweise ablösen könnte.

Echtzeit-Buchungen und verifizierte Unternehmensdaten im Chat.

Verwaltung über das neue OpenAI-Unternehmensportal.

it.content:
OpenAI lancia una sfida aperta a Google Search introducendo i Profili Aziendali verificati all'interno di ChatGPT. La novità permette agli utenti di consultare orari, cataloghi e completare prenotazioni in chat.

L'aggiornamento trasforma ChatGPT in un hub di commercio conversazionale, riducendo la dipendenza dai classici motori di ricerca.

Si apre ufficialmente l'era della Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), dove essere visibili agli agenti AI diventa la priorità strategica per ogni brand.

Alternativa diretta alle schede Google Business Profile.
Prenotazioni e assistenza clienti integrate nella chat.

ja.title: OpenAIがGoogle検索に対抗：ChatGPTに対話型『公式ビジネスプロフィール』を導入
ja.summary: OpenAIはChatGPT内に認証済みビジネスプロフィールを公開。店舗情報、予約、顧客対応がチャット内で完結可能に。
ja.content:
OpenAIはGoogle検索やローカルビジネス機能に対抗し、ChatGPT内に公式ビジネスプロフィール機能を導入しました。企業は営業時間や製品カタログを認証バッジ付きで表示し、チャット内で直接予約を受け付けることができます。

これによりChatGPTは単なる情報検索ツールから、ユーザーに代わってアクションを実行する対話型コマースプラットフォームへと進化しました。

従来のSEOに代わり、生成AIエージェントに最適化する『Generative Engine Optimization（GEO）』が今後の企業戦略の中心になると注目されています。
keyTakeaways: ChatGPT内に公式認証ビジネスプロフィールを導入。
Googleビジネスプロフィールに対抗する対話型コマース機能。
チャット画面から離れずに予約・問い合わせ・購入が可能。
従来のSEOから『GEO（生成エンジン最適化）』への転換が加速。
企業専用のダッシュボードからプロフィール認証と管理が可能。

en.title: Nvidia’s Crisis Has Corporate Governance Experts Reaching for the Popcorn
en.summary: Corporate governance analysts and Wall Street regulators are scrutinizing Nvidia's internal leadership oversight amid mounting supply chain pressure and geopolitical tensions.
en.content:
As Nvidia maintains its dominant position in the artificial intelligence compute ecosystem, governance experts are raising critical concerns regarding board independence, high-velocity leadership demands, and risk disclosures. The unprecedented concentration of market value in a single semiconductor architect has magnified every executive move into a systemic market event.

Regulatory bodies across the United States and Europe are actively reviewing how large AI hardware monopolies manage international distribution protocols and state-level compliance. With supply constraints continuing to shape enterprise AI software roadmaps, the margin for operational error has shrunk to near zero.

Institutional investors are demanding enhanced transparency protocols, urging the semiconductor giant to institutionalize its risk architecture beyond charismatic executive direction and ensure resilient corporate governance across its global supply footprint.
keyTakeaways: Corporate governance watchdogs scrutinize Nvidia's executive oversight structures.
Market value concentration in AI compute creates heightened systemic risk.
International regulators intensify oversight on global AI chip distribution.
Supply chain bottlenecks directly impact enterprise software deployment schedules.
Institutional investors demand institutionalized compliance beyond charismatic executive leadership.

tr.title: Nvidia'da Yönetişim Krizi: Kurumsal Uzmanlar ve Wall Street Alarmda
tr.summary: Yapay zeka çip pazarını domine eden Nvidia, tedarik zinciri baskısı ve uluslararası düzenleyici denetimler sebebiyle kurumsal yönetişim uzmanlarının merceği altına girdi.
tr.content:
Yapay zeka hesaplama altyapısının mutlak lideri Nvidia, pazar değerinin tek bir yarı iletken devinde toplanmasının getirdiği sistemik riskler nedeniyle kurumsal yönetişim otoriteleri tarafından sıkı takibe alındı. Yönetim kurulu bağımsızlığı, liderlik baskıları ve küresel dağıtım riskleri her geçen gün daha fazla tartışılıyor.

Amerika Birleşik Devletleri ve Avrupa'daki düzenleyici kurumlar, yapay zeka çiplerinin küresel tedarik protokollerini ve uluslararası uyumluluk standartlarını mercek altına almış durumda. Kurumsal yazılım şirketlerinin büyüme planlarının doğrudan donanım teslimatlarına bağlı olması, operasyonel hata payını sıfıra indiriyor.

Kurumsal yatırımcılar, şirketin kriz yönetim mimarisini yalnızca karizmatik liderlik ekseninden çıkarıp şeffaf ve kurumsallaşmış risk yönetim standartlarına bağlamasını talep ediyor.
keyTakeaways: Kurumsal yönetişim uzmanları Nvidia'nın liderlik ve denetim mekanizmalarını inceliyor.
Yapay zeka çip pazarındaki aşırı sermaye yoğunlaşması sistemik risk yaratıyor.
Uluslararası regülatörler çip tedarik protokolleri üzerindeki denetimlerini artırıyor.
Donanım tedarik zincirindeki aksamalar kurumsal yapay zeka yol haritalarını etkiliyor.
Yatırımcılar, lider odaklı yapı yerine kurumsallaşmış şeffaflık standartları talep ediyor.

es.title: La Crisis de Gobernanza en Nvidia Despierta la Alerta en Wall Street
es.summary: Expertos en gobernanza corporativa y reguladores examinan la estructura de liderazgo de Nvidia ante la presión en la cadena de suministro de chips de IA.
es.content: Con Nvidia liderando la infraestructura computacional de la IA global, analistas alertan sobre la dependencia extrema del mercado en un solo fabricante. Las tensiones geopolíticas y la alta demanda de GPUs exigen una gobernanza corporativa mucho más robusta y transparente.
keyTakeaways: Supervisión reforzada sobre el directorio y las decisiones estratégicas de Nvidia.
Riesgo sistémico por concentración de mercado en infraestructura de IA.
Presión de inversores institucionales por mayor transparencia operativa.

Systemische Risiken durch Konzentration des KI-Hardwaremarktes.
Forderungen nach institutionalisierten Risiko- und Compliance-Prozessen.

en.title: OpenAI Acquires Odessia, the AI Travel Agent Platform Founded by Sonder's Creator
en.summary: OpenAI has acquired Odessia to integrate autonomous itinerary generation, live booking mechanics, and spatial travel planning directly into ChatGPT.
en.content:
Expanding its push into agentic vertical commerce, OpenAI has acquired Odessia, the travel intelligence startup launched by Sonder's founder. Odessia specialized in multi-modal itinerary optimization, live hospitality APIs, and dynamic re-routing algorithms.

The strategic acquisition equips OpenAI with proprietary transaction pipes and travel provider integrations, positioning ChatGPT to execute full-journey reservations rather than offering static recommendations.

With travel technology representing one of the largest consumer transaction categories, the move puts OpenAI in direct collision with Expedia, Booking.com, and Google Travel.
keyTakeaways: OpenAI completes strategic acquisition of travel intelligence platform Odessia.
Enables ChatGPT to execute real-time flight, lodging, and itinerary bookings.
Accelerates OpenAI's evolution from answer bot into autonomous transaction agent.
Direct threat to legacy online travel agencies (OTAs) including Expedia and Booking.
Odessia's engineering team transitions to OpenAI's consumer product division.

tr.title: OpenAI'dan Dev Satın Alma: Yapay Zeka Seyahat Girişimi Odessia'yı Bünyesine Kattı
tr.summary: OpenAI, Sonder'ın kurucusu tarafından hayata geçirilen yapay zeka seyahat ve rezervasyon platformu Odessia'yı satın aldığını duyurdu.
tr.content:
Yapay zeka ajanlarını doğrudan ticaret ve işlem yapabilen platformlara dönüştürmeyi hedefleyen OpenAI, Odessia'yı satın aldı. Odessia'nın geliştirdiği seyahat zekası; dinamik rota optimizasyonu, otel ve uçuş API entegrasyonları ile anlık rezervasyon motorunu ChatGPT ekosistemine taşıyor.

Kullanıcılar artık ChatGPT'ye sadece tatil planı sormayacak; bilet alımından otel rezervasyonuna ve takvim senkronizasyonuna kadar tüm süreci tek bir komutla tamamlayabilecek.

Bu hamle OpenAI'ı Expedia, Booking.com ve Google Travel gibi köklü seyahat devleriyle doğrudan kafa kafaya getiriyor.
keyTakeaways: OpenAI, yapay zeka tabanlı seyahat platformu Odessia'yı satın aldı.
ChatGPT üzerinden uçuş ve konaklama rezervasyonları anlık olarak yapılabilecek.
OpenAI, statik cevap motorundan otonom işlem ve satın alma ajanına dönüşüyor.
Booking.com ve Expedia gibi geleneksel platformlar için doğrudan pazar tehdidi.
Odessia'nın mühendislik kadrosu OpenAI tüketici ürünleri ekibine katıldı.

ExpediaやBooking.comなど既存OTA市場への直接的な挑戦。

en.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Meetings to Transform Workplace Discussions into Actionable Code & Tasks
en.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Meetings, an enterprise tool that listens to engineering scrums and syncs, automatically generating PR plans, Linear tasks, and codebase pull requests.
en.content:
Targeting the friction between software planning and implementation, Anthropic unveiled 'Claude Meetings'. The platform transcribes technical voice discussions, extracts architectural decisions, and links directly with developer tools like GitHub, Linear, and Jira.

Rather than outputting simple meeting minutes, Claude Meetings synthesizes precise technical specifications, drafts initial pull requests, and assigns dependencies across engineering teams.

Enterprise IT organizations view this as a major step toward ambient engineering, where developer meetings immediately generate executable engineering tickets without manual administrative overhead.
keyTakeaways: Anthropic debuts Claude Meetings for technical teams and software engineers.
Automatically converts meeting audio into GitHub PR drafts and Linear tickets.
Preserves architectural decisions and maps dependencies across repositories.
Integrates enterprise security protocols with zero training on customer data.
Direct enterprise competitor to Microsoft Teams AI Copilot and Zoom AI Companion.

tr.title: Anthropic'ten Claude Meetings: Toplantıları Otonom Kod Planlarına ve Görevlere Dönüştürüyor
tr.summary: Anthropic, mühendislik ve ürün toplantılarını analiz edip doğrudan GitHub PR taslaklarına ve Linear görevlerine dönüştüren 'Claude Meetings' aracını duyurdu.
tr.content:
Anthropic, yazılım ekiplerinin toplantılarda aldığı teknik kararları doğrudan çalışan kod planlarına çeviren 'Claude Meetings' sistemini tanıttı. Sistem, sesli tartışmaları dinleyerek mimari gereksinimleri ayıklıyor ve doğrudan GitHub, Linear ve Jira ile senkronize ediyor.

Basit bir toplantı özeti çıkarmak yerine; teknik şartnameleri oluşturuyor, bağımlılıkları haritalıyor ve geliştiriciler için hazır Pull Request taslakları üretiyor.

Bu araç, mühendislik ekiplerinin saatler süren dokümantasyon ve görev açma yükünü ortadan kaldırarak otonom yazılım geliştirme sürecini hızlandırıyor.
keyTakeaways: Anthropic, yazılım ve ürün ekipleri için Claude Meetings'i kullanıma sundu.
Ses kayıtlarını anında GitHub PR taslaklarına ve Linear görevlerine dönüştürüyor.
Toplantıdaki teknik kararları mimari bağımlılıklarla eşleştiriyor.
Müşteri verileri üzerinde model eğitimi yapılmayan kurumsal güvenlik yapısı.
Microsoft Copilot ve Zoom AI Companion'a karşı doğrudan geliştirici odaklı alternatif.

es.title: Anthropic Lanza Claude Meetings: Convierte Reuniones en Tareas de Código y GitHub PRs

keyTakeaways: Generación automática de PRs y especificaciones técnicas desde audio.
Integración nativa con GitHub, Linear y Jira.
Enfoque empresarial con estricta privacidad de datos.

keyTakeaways: Création de pull requests et tickets à partir de réunions vocales.
Gain de temps substantiel sur la documentation technique.
Alternative puissante aux solutions généralistes comme Teams Copilot.

de.summary: Claude Meetings transkribiert technische Diskussionen und generiert automatisch GitHub Pull Requests sowie Projekt-Tickets.
de.content: Entwicklerteams können technische Besprechungen nun nahtlos in Code-Spezifikationen und Aufgaben überführen, ohne manuelle Dokumentation verfassen zu müssen.

Tiefe Integration in Entwicklungs-Workflows.
Höchste Datenschutzstandards für Unternehmenssoftware.

it.title: Anthropic Presenta Claude Meetings: Le Riunioni Diventano Codice e Task su GitHub
it.summary: Claude Meetings converte le discussioni dei team di sviluppo in specifiche tecniche, PR su GitHub e task su Linear.
it.content: La nuova piattaforma di Anthropic elimina il divario tra pianificazione vocale ed esecuzione software, accelerando il ciclo di vita dei progetti.
keyTakeaways: Conversione intelligente di meeting vocali in PR di codice.
Sincronizzazione immediata con Jira, Linear e GitHub.
Sicurezza enterprise e privacy totale sui dati aziendali.

ja.title: Anthropicが『Claude Meetings』を発表：会議の音声からGitHub PRとタスクを自動生成

Linear、Jira、GitHubとのシームレスな双方向連携。
顧客データを学習に使用しない厳格なエンタープライズセキュリティ。
Microsoft Teams CopilotやZoomに対抗するエンジニア特化型AI。

en.title: Anthropic IPO Filings Reveal $250M Cash-Out Per Founder in Historic AI Listing
en.summary: Regulatory filings for Anthropic's anticipated public listing indicate all seven co-founders could each realize roughly $250 million in liquid secondary sales.
en.content:
As Anthropic readies what could become one of the most consequential tech IPOs of the decade, confidential regulatory disclosures reveal a liquidity provision that would grant each of its seven original founders an estimated $250 million payout.

The provisions reflect unprecedented institutional confidence in the AI lab's enterprise revenue trajectory, buoyed by multi-billion-dollar enterprise commitments from AWS, Google Cloud, and global corporate cohorts.

Market observers note that structured secondary liquidity for founding teams before or during an IPO has become standard practice among premier foundation model labs, balancing retention with intense talent competition.
keyTakeaways: Anthropic IPO structuring includes ~$250M liquidity per co-founder.
Signifies institutional backing for enterprise-first foundation model labs.
AWS and Google Cloud enterprise cloud partnerships fuel record revenue milestones.
Sets a valuation benchmark for upcoming generative AI public offerings.
Leadership remains tied to long-term equity vesting and multi-year governance commitments.

tr.title: Anthropic Halka Arzı Netleşiyor: 7 Kurucu Ortağın Her Biri Yaklaşık 250M$ Nakit Alacak
tr.summary: Anthropic'in beklenen halka arz (IPO) başvuru belgeleri, şirketin yedi kurucu ortağının her birine yaklaşık 250 milyon dolarlık nakit çıkış imkanı tanıyacağını ortaya koydu.
tr.content:
Yapay zeka ekosisteminin en büyük halka arzlarından birine hazırlanan Anthropic, kurucu ekibin nakit çıkışına olanak tanıyan özel bir yapılandırmayla piyasaya açılıyor. Belgeler, şirketin 7 kurucu ortağının her birinin yaklaşık 250 milyon dolar elde edebileceğini gösteriyor.

AWS ve Google Cloud ile yapılan milyarlarca dolarlık bulut anlaşmaları ve kurumsal abone sayısındaki patlama, yatırımcıların şirketin gelir büyümesine olan güvenini pekiştiriyor.

Uzmanlar, yapay zeka sektöründeki aşırı yetenek rekabeti nedeniyle kuruculara halka arz öncesinde veya sırasında likidite sağlanmasının artık silikon vadisinde yeni bir standart haline geldiğini vurguluyor.
keyTakeaways: Anthropic halka arzında kurucu ortak başına yaklaşık 250 milyon dolarlık likidite planlanıyor.
Kurumsal AI pazarındaki rekor büyüme Wall Street güvenini artırıyor.
AWS ve Google Cloud ortaklıkları şirketin gelirlerini tarihi seviyelere taşıdı.
Yapay zeka şirketlerinin halka açılma süreçleri için yeni bir değerleme çıtası oluşturuyor.
Kurucu ekip uzun vadeli hisse hak ediş takvimleriyle şirkete bağlı kalmaya devam edecek.

Fatturato record trainato dalle partnership con Google e Amazon.
Punto di riferimento per le future quotazioni nel settore dell'IA.

en.title: PSI Pioneers Autonomous AI Agents for Commercial Scientific Discovery
en.summary: Deep tech startup PSI has launched autonomous AI agents capable of formulating hypotheses, simulating laboratory experiments, and patenting breakthroughs in materials science and biology.
en.content:
Scientific research is entering an autonomous era as startup PSI unveils an enterprise AI engine built for end-to-end scientific breakthroughs. Rather than serving as passive literature search tools, PSI's models generate novel molecular compounds, predict physical reactions, and validate experimental designs computationally.

The venture aims to slash the traditional 10-year lab cycle for new pharmaceutical and semiconductor materials down to weeks. By partnering with leading universities and industrial conglomerates, PSI is monetizing AI-generated intellectual property through licensing partnerships.

This marks a transition from consumer generative AI toward mission-critical foundational science, where autonomous agents produce verifiable physical value rather than simple text synthesis.
keyTakeaways: PSI deploys autonomous AI agents dedicated to physics, chemistry, and drug discovery.
Reduces multi-year laboratory trial timelines down to computational weeks.
Monetizes scientific breakthroughs through IP licensing and industrial co-development.
Integrates generative hypothesis testing with automated physical lab simulations.
Signals the evolution of AI agents into mission-critical deep science industries.

tr.title: Yapay Zeka Bilimsel Keşifleri Otonom Hale Getiriyor: PSI'dan Çığır Açan AI Ajanları
tr.summary: Derin teknoloji girişimi PSI; kimya, malzeme bilimi ve ilaç geliştirmede hipotez kurup deney simülasyonu yapabilen otonom AI ajanlarını duyurdu.
tr.content:
Bilimsel araştırma süreçleri, PSI girişiminin tanıttığı otonom bilim motoruyla yeni bir boyuta ulaşıyor. Geleneksel olarak yıllar süren laboratuvar testleri ve moleküler analizler, yapay zeka ajanlarının fiziksel kanunlara göre çalıştırdığı simülasyonlarla haftalar mertebesine indiriliyor.

Sistem yalnızca literatür taramakla kalmıyor; yeni molekül dizilimleri öneriyor, kimyasal reaksiyonları simüle ediyor ve patentlenebilir formüller ortaya çıkarıyor. Sanayi devleri ve araştırma enstitüleriyle iş birliği yapan PSI, yapay zekanın ürettiği fikri mülkiyetleri lisanslayarak gelir elde ediyor.

Bu gelişme, yapay zekanın sadece metin yazan tüketici araçlarından çıkıp fiziksel dünyada gerçek bilimsel ve endüstriyel değer üreten bir güce dönüştüğünü gösteriyor.
keyTakeaways: PSI, fizik, kimya ve biyoteknoloji alanında otonom araştırma yapan AI ajanları geliştirdi.
Geleneksel laboratuvar deneme süreçlerini yıllardan haftalara düşürüyor.
Patentlenebilir buluşlar üreterek fikri mülkiyet lisanslama modeliyle çalışıyor.
Üretici hipotez testlerini otomatik laboratuvar simülasyonlarıyla birleştiriyor.
Yapay zeka ajanlarının temel bilimler ve kritik endüstrilerdeki yükselişini temsil ediyor.

es.title: La IA Revoluciona la Ciencia: PSI Lanza Agentes Autónomos para el Descubrimiento Científico
es.summary: La startup PSI presenta agentes de inteligencia artificial capaces de formular hipótesis y simular experimentos en biomedicina y ciencia de materiales.
es.content: La investigación científica entra en una era autónoma gracias a PSI, que ha desarrollado agentes de IA diseñados para acelerar descubrimientos de laboratorio.
keyTakeaways: Agentes de IA autónomos dedicados a la física, química y medicina.
Reducción radical de tiempos en el descubrimiento de nuevos materiales.
Monetización de hallazgos científicos mediante licencias de propiedad intelectual.

fr.title: La Découverte Scientifique Devient Autonome : PSI Déploie ses Agents IA de Pointe

fr.content: La recherche scientifique franchit un cap historique avec la plateforme de PSI. Ses agents autonomes modélisent des structures moléculaires inédites.
keyTakeaways: Agents IA spécialisés en physique, chimie et découverte de médicaments.
Accélération drastique des cycles de recherche en laboratoire.
Modèle économique fondé sur la concession de brevets scientifiques.

de.title: Autonome KI für die Wissenschaft: PSI revolutioniert industrielle Entdeckungen

keyTakeaways: Autonome KI-Agenten für Physik, Chemie und pharmazeutische Forschung.
Verkürzung mehrjähriger Entwicklungszyklen auf wenige Wochen.
Monetarisierung wissenschaftlicher Durchbrüche über Lizenzmodelle.

it.title: L'IA al Servizio della Ricerca: PSI Lancia Agenti Autonomi per la Scoperta Scientifica

Drastica riduzione dei tempi di sperimentazione in laboratorio.
Monetizzazione delle scoperte tramite licenze di brevetti.

ja.title: 科学的発見を自律化：ディープテック企業PSIが実験シミュレーションAIエージェントを発表
ja.summary: 米PSIは、化学・バイオ・新素材分野で仮説立案から実験シミュレーションまでを自律実行するAIエージェントを公開。
ja.content: 科学研究の現場に自律型AIが本格導入されようとしています。PSIが発表したAIエージェントは、新規化合物の予測や物理実験のシミュレーションを自律的に遂行します。
keyTakeaways: 物理・化学・創薬分野に特化した自律型AIエージェント。
研究開発期間を数年からわずか数週間に大幅短縮。
科学的ブレークスルーを特許化し、産業パートナーへライセンス提供。
